map.Capstone Remix · Part 1 — part of the Bo: Capstone Remix · Part 1. This is part of the Boundless arc. statistics, ratios & percent remix · Units 2–4. Read from start to end. Each gate gives hints and a worked example. It does not stop you.
map.Episode 1. Same crew, same city — one fo: Episode 1. Same crew. Same city. One part of the case. Turn the page when you are set.
map.If you can hear this, my Pattern Engine: Can you hear this? Then my Pattern Engine is fully awake. And it found friends. One last game, crew. Go to the places from this year. Solve one small, fun thing at each. Then come home to the Engine Heart.
map.That's her. The real Ada Vex. A hundred: That's her. The real Ada Vex. She is a hundred years away. And she planned us a party.
map.I was born in The Pattern Engine. I woul: I was born in The Pattern Engine. I want to see how the story ends.
map.First stop on Ada's map: the festival gr: First stop on Ada's map: the fair. A tiny drawing marks it. It shows a sorted list.
map.The festival grounds. Banners from every: The fair. Flags hang from each year the crew has saved.
map.Remember The Crooked Census? Someone rig: Do you know The Crooked Census? Someone set up this board to look low. We sorted it out. For real.
map.Ada's remix is friendlier: the middle of: Ada's remix is nicer. First, the middle of five true days. Then the fair share of three extra shows.
map.The median is the middle value of a sort: The median: the middle value of a sorted list. The mean shares the total out equally. An outlier is a value far from the rest. It pulls hard on the mean.
map.You first, fifth crew member. One year o: You first, crew member five. One year of stats. Show us the middle.
map.Five festival days drew 7, 9, 12, 15, 20: Five fair days had 7, 9, 12, 15, 20 visitors (in hundreds). PART A: find the median. PART B: the three extra shows got 10, 14, 18 cheers (in hundreds). Find the mean.
map.Conceptual: the median is a POSITION, no: Conceptual: the median is a POSITION, not a sum. Sort the list. Find the value right in the middle seat. The mean is a SHARE. The whole total is split equally to each value.
map.Procedural: sort the five numbers, then: Procedural: sort the five numbers. Then cross one off each end. Stop when one value is left. For the mean, add the three counts. That makes one total. Then divide that total by the number of counts.
map.The Courier Cup route! Full Velocity — t: The Courier Cup route! Full Velocity. We out-divided Team Torque that day.
map.A ratio compares quantities in order. A: A ratio compares amounts in order. A unit rate: the amount for just ONE unit. Here, that is km per one minute.
map.Equivalent ratios grow in step: multiply: Equivalent ratios grow in step. Multiply both parts by the same factor. Then the ratio stays true.
map.Pedal the numbers, reader. The route rem: Pedal the numbers, reader. The route knows how.
map.Ada's remix card, part one: keep the gea: Ada's remix card, part one: keep the gear ratio equivalent. 2 : 3 = 8 : ▢. Part two, the old one: 12 km in 30 minutes. What is the unit rate in km per minute?
map.Conceptual: equivalent ratios grow in st: Conceptual: equivalent ratios grow in step. Multiply BOTH parts by the same factor. A unit rate asks: how far in just ONE minute?
map.Procedural: find the factor that turns 2: Procedural: find the factor that turns 2 into 8. Then multiply 3 by that same factor. For the rate, divide the kilometers by the minutes.
map.The night market on the pier — the one t: The night market on the pier. The crew saved it with percents.
map.The Hundred Market! Still smells like ca: The Hundred Market! It still smells like caramel and a win.
map.Remix: 250 lanterns, and 40% light at su: Remix: 250 lanterns, and 40% light up at sunset. And I counted 30 gold ones. That is exactly 50% of the gold crate.
map.A percent is a count per hundred. You ca: A percent is a count per hundred. You can find a part from the whole. Or go back from a part to the whole. We do both ways tonight.
map.Light them up, reader. The pier's waitin: Light them up, reader. The pier is waiting for you.
map.The night market hangs 250 lanterns, and: The night market has 250 lanterns. 40% light up at sunset. How many is that? Then: Theo's 30 gold lanterns are exactly 50% of the gold crate. How many lanterns fill the whole crate?
map.Conceptual: a percent counts per hundred: Conceptual: a percent counts per hundred. Part = percent of the whole. Do you know a part AND its percent? Then you can go back to the whole.
map.Procedural: find 10% of 250 by dividing: Procedural: find 10% of 250. Divide by ten. Then scale up to 40%. For the crate: 50% is one half. So the whole is double the part you know.
map.The full story — Boundless — is glowing: The full story is Boundless. It glows at the city gate. — A.V.

map.Cross off the ends in pairs: 4 & 30 go,: Cross off the ends in pairs: 4 & 30 go. Then 8 & 13. The value left in the middle, 11, is the median.
map.Mean practice on another list: 6, 9, 15: Mean practice on a new list: 6, 9, 15. The total is 30. Share it with 3 values: 30 ÷ 3 = 10.
map.Your turn — same idea, different numbers: Your turn. Same idea, new numbers:
Scale a new ratio: 3 : 5 = 9 : ▢. The factor is 3 × 3 = 9. So the partner is 5 × 3 = 15.
map.Check it: 0.5 × 20 = 10. The unit rate r: Check it: 0.5 × 20 = 10. The unit rate builds the whole trip again.
map.A different stall: 20% of 150 cocoa cups: A new stall: 20% of 150 cocoa cups. 10% of 150 is 15. So 20% is 15 × 2 = 30 cups.
Go back: 18 is 25% of a crate. 25% fits four times into the whole. So the crate holds 18 × 4 = 72.
map.Sanity check: a whole is always BIGGER t: Sense check: is the percent under a hundred? Then a whole is always BIGGER than its part.
map.That's not the middle of the sorted list: That is not the middle of the sorted list. First, line up the five days. Go from small to big.
map.You found the TOTAL of the three shows —: You found the TOTAL of the three shows. Now share it out equally. Divide by how many shows there are.
map.The mean shares the total equally: add a: The mean shares the total equally. Add all three counts first. Then divide by the number of counts.
map.Median 12, mean 14 — the festival node h: Median 12, mean 14. The fair hums awake. Each flag snaps up. One down!
map.The 2 grew into 8 — what factor did that: The 2 grew into 8. What factor did that? The 3 must grow by that same factor.
map.Distance ÷ minutes gives km per ONE minu: Distance ÷ minutes gives km per ONE minute. Try the division again.
map.8 : 12 keeps the ratio true, and 0.4 km: 8 : 12 keeps the ratio true. And 0.4 km per minute. Maya's legs know each meter. On we go!
map.Step through it: 10% of 250 first, then: Go step by step: 10% of 250 first. Then four of those make 40%.
map.Careful — 30 is only HALF the crate. Wal: Be careful. 30 is only HALF the crate. Go back to the whole.
map.100 lanterns blaze at sunset and the gol: 100 lanterns shine at sunset. The gold crate holds 60. The pier glows. It knows it was saved.
Yes! Now go back and open that gate.
